info.title: PinkDreams VMS API
info.description: Video Management System API for Camera Management, Streaming, Notifications, and Business Operations

get.description: Simple endpoint to test API connectivity

post.description: Authenticate user and return JWT token
Get a new JWT token using existing valid token
Invalidate JWT token and logout user

get.description: Retrieve paginated list of cameras with optional filters (status, protocol, server, location, streaming state, search)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by camera name or manufacturer

post.description: Add a new camera to the system. Checks camera limits based on subscription package.

403.description: Camera limit exceeded for this business package

get.description: Retrieve camera counts by status and streaming state
Retrieve detailed information about a specific camera including stream URL

put.description: Update camera configuration including RTSP/RTMP settings, location, status, and technical specs

delete.description: Soft delete a camera from the system

patch.description: Quick update of camera comments field only (for inline editing)
Move camera processing to a different VMS server (super-admin or business-admin only)

get.description: Retrieve predefined list of camera manufacturers for dropdown selection
Retrieve current authenticated user's profile information

post.description: Update user's personal profile details (name, email, phone, etc.)
Upload or update user's profile picture (JPEG, PNG, GIF - max 5MB)

picture.description: Profile picture file (JPEG, PNG, GIF - max 5MB)

422.description: Invalid file or file too large

post.description: Change the current user's password with verification of existing password

new_password.description: New password (min 8 chars, must differ from current)

message.example: Please login again with your new password

422.description: Validation error - password too weak or does not match confirmation

post.description: Start FFmpeg process to convert RTSP/RTMP to HLS format for web playback
Stop FFmpeg streaming process and cleanup HLS files

get.description: Check if camera stream is active and retrieve stream details including process status
Serve HLS playlist (.m3u8) or video segments (.ts) for video playback

404.description: Camera not found or Stream file not found

403.description: Unauthorized access to this camera stream

get.description: Retrieve list of all cameras currently streaming

post.description: Stop and restart FFmpeg streaming process (useful for recovering from errors)

bearerAuth.description: Enter JWT token in format: Bearer {token}
